Submit a Job to a slurmpilot Scheduler Backend

Source: R/job.R
slurm_submit.Rd

Submits either a pre-built slurm_job_spec() or a fun + args_list workload to any SlurmBackend (such as MockSlurmBackend or SlurmSshBackend).

Usage

slurm_submit(
  backend,
  fun,
  args_list = NULL,
  resources = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  packages = character(),
  globals = list(),
  seed = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

backend

A SlurmBackend R6 object.

fun

Either a slurmpilot_job_spec object OR a worker function fun(arg).

args_list

List of per-task arguments (required when fun is a function).

resources

Optional slurmpilot_resources object.

name

Optional job name.

packages

Character vector of worker packages.

globals

Named list of worker globals.

seed

Optional integer base seed.

...

Additional backend-specific arguments forwarded to backend$submit() (e.g. fault_injection for MockSlurmBackend).

Value

A slurmpilot_job handle.

See also

slurm_status(), slurm_wait(), slurm_retry(), slurm_collect()

Examples

be <- mock_slurm_backend(max_workers = 1L)
job <- slurm_submit(be, function(x) x + 1, as.list(1:4),
                    resources = resource_spec(4L, chunk_size = 2L))
st <- slurm_wait(job, poll_interval = 0.05)
slurm_collect(job, simplify = TRUE)
#> [1] 2 3 4 5
unlink(be$root_dir, recursive = TRUE)
